description: This file declares the exported API functions for the Sys Rro Bool Object in the BroadWay Runtime System environment. It provides function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the object.

methods.name: SysCreateRroBool
methods.description: Factory function to create a Sys Rro Bool object with provided container and owner contexts.

methods.name: SysRroBoolCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Sys Rro Bool object.

methods.name: SysRroBoolRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the Sys Rro Bool object instance.

methods.name: SysRroBoolEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary objects or components into the Sys Rro Bool object.

methods.name: SysRroBoolInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Sys Rro Bool object instance.
